headline: Drones enter Romanian airspace from Moldova direction

sources: Romanian Ministry of National Defence statement via public broadcaster TVR (as reported by Cedar News); Romanian Ministry of Foreign Affairs Facebook post Oct 31 17:51 UTC
fault_line: Scrambling F-16s against cheap drones: necessary NATO defence or wasteful overreaction? Commenters split on cost-effectiveness and demand missing details (shot down? origin? interception time?).

sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT -- incursion, scramble, alerts] An aerial target entered Romanian airspace without authorisation from the direction of Moldova on Saturday Oct 31; Romania scrambled 4 F-16 fighter jets and an IAR-330 SOCAT helicopter and issued RO-Alert warnings (Cedar/TVR: 5 counties Iasi, Neamt, Vaslui, Bacau, Botosani; MFA Facebook post: 6 counties, adding Suceava, and one drone visually observed). [ATTRIBUTED REPORT -- origin/path, UNVERIFIED] Falcon Intel tracking put a drone at ~179 km/h from northern Moldova toward Botosani near Edinet-Briceni; that tracking is explicitly unverified and the Romanian MoD statement as reported does NOT attribute the target to Russia or any actor. No shootdown, damage or casualty reported for this incident.
sections.what_verified: Primary-source single family: Romanian government (MoD statement + MFA post). Cedar News and Medium daily are conduits/aggregators with NO declared tier in the source registry and do not count toward corroboration.
sections.what_disputed: No Russian attribution in the MoD statement as reported; Falcon Intel path/speed figures unverified; county count differs between Cedar/TVR (5) and MFA post (6, adding Suceava). Oct 17-18 shootdowns of 2 Geran drones over the Black Sea are a separate, earlier incident, not this one.
sections.why_matters: NATO jets scrambled for a drone nobody will name: 4 F-16s, 6 counties on alert, zero attribution. The map shows the Moldova-direction entry; the fault line is the cost of chasing cheap drones with fighter jets.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (Oct 31 evening, absent from Oct 31 and 0000-0400 Nov 1 scans; surfaced in-window via Medium Ukraine War Daily 00:12Z and demand sweep) -- Drones enter Romanian airspace from Moldova direction; 4 F-16s scrambled, RO-Alerts in 6 counties
